steps.message: You want this to apply automatically in every new terminal you open on this Windows machine going forward, not just the current shell session -- that changes which form of the setting to use.

$env:DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER="true" in PowerShell only lasts for that one session's process, so it wouldn't carry over to a freshly opened terminal. For a persistent user-level setting on Windows, use setx DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER true instead -- new terminals and processes then inherit it. Set the dotnet CLI variable rather than MSBUILDUSESERVER, because the CLI derives and overwrites that internal value.

One caveat: setx DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER true only affects new processes started after you run it -- your currently open terminal won't see the change until you open a new one (or also set $env:DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER="true" in the current session if you want it active immediately, too).
